design.base_universe: Risk-on, liquid US stocks from survivorship-aware active and delisted sample
design.binary_signal: ETF ratio positive over trailing 20 trading days
design.continuous_signal: Magnitude of ETF relative return over pre-registered 20, 60, and 120 trading-day windows
design.portfolio: Top quintile of each predefined technical combination
design.outcome: 10-day next-open excess return versus eligible universe after 20 bps cost
design.inference: 2,000 deterministic paired bootstrap samples; 95% interval; all 54 development p-values controlled together with Benjamini-Hochberg
design.warning: Six contexts times three combinations times three windows creates 54 hypotheses; no result is promoted without corrected development evidence and later-period confirmation.
